name: Display Brightness (ddcutil)
description:
Brightness sliders for every external monitor that ddcutil detects, in Quick Settings or the top bar.

Requires ddcutil and access to the /dev/i2c devices. Setup instructions: https://github.com/Tim-van-Oudheusden/gnome-display-brightness-ddcutil#setting-up-ddcutil

A fork of Brightness control using ddcutil by daitj.
